newsitem.title: USA: Chase Asset Management names emerging markets head.
newsitem.headline: Chase Asset Management names emerging markets head.

text.p: Chase Asset Management, the institutional management arm of Chase Manhattan Bank's Global Asset Management & Private Banking division, said on Thursday that it appointed Craig Blessing as head of emerging markets.

In his new position, Blessing will be responsible for managing emerging market debt portfolios for fund products and institutional accounts. He will report to Mark Richardson, chief investment officer of Global Asset Management.
Blessing will co-manage the Chase Vista International Yield Fund and work closely with Chase's Gordon Ross, head of global bonds in London.
Blessing was previously director of the Fund Managment Group and portfolio manager of emerging markets bond funds at Serfin Securities Inc.

"The expertise that Craig brings to our team in the area of emerging markets will heighten our visibility in the global marketplace and significantly enhance the services and products we provide to our institutional, mutual-fund and private banking client base," Richardson said.
